maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from renting and selling DURA-BASE composite mats for new project site access, not repairing or servicing installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private utilities, pipeline and energy companies renting mats for projects, not government agencies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by renting and selling its own DURA-BASE mats; only a few small acquisitions like WGS, UAS, Lentzcaping.

mission_critical.reason: Temporary matting rentals for work pads and access roads can be switched to other mat suppliers fairly easily.

notes: Mat rental and sales is the larger business; a smaller environmental services business also exists.
